stories.title: Commanders' Jayden Daniels-themed post aimed at Bengals tops NFL Week 11 trolls
stories.summary: NFL teams remained petty in Week 11, led by a post from the Washington Commanders.
stories.detail: The unlikeliest of victories can often feel the sweetest -- especially when it can be capped with a troll. The Washington Commanders beat the Cincinnati Bengals 22-20 on "Monday Night Football." Washington faced a one-point deficit with 46 seconds left after Cincinnati kicked a go-ahead field goal. The Commanders, though, had the last laugh. Quarterback Jayden Daniels connected with wide receiver Antonio Williams twice during the final drive, including a 42-yard reception that set up a field goal. Drew Stevens nailed the 26-yarder as time expired, ensuring Washington's victory. The Commanders poked fun at the Bengals on social media in clever fashion. They posted a clip from a 2001 episode of the talk show "Maury," during which someone on the show shares their phobia of aluminum foil. While on stage, someone walks toward them with aluminum foil, prompting them to run off stage and yell, "Get away from me." Washington put its spin on the video, editing the host Maury Povich as "Monday Night Football," the lady with the aluminum foil fear as the Bengals and the aluminum foil as Daniels, who is 2-0 against the Bengals on "Monday Night Football." stories.title: Commanders building momentum, halt Bengals' 5-game win streak
stories.summary: The Commanders' defense held the potent Bengals in check and Washington has won three of four.
stories.detail: LANDOVER, Md. -- The Washington Commanders needed a win to keep pace in the NFC East. They not only got a win, their defense made a statement. The Commanders upset the Cincinnati Bengals 22-20 on a last-second 28-yard field goal by Drew Stevens to win their second game in a row and third in their last four. It's the first time they've won consecutive games since the 2024 season. Quarterback Jayden Daniels needed only two passes -- 23 yards and 42 yards into tight windows -- to lead the Commanders into field goal position. They improved to 4-5-1. A loss would have dropped them three games behind the first-place New York Giants in the NFC East. Though Daniels led the final drive, it was the defense that kept the Commanders around all night. It held the NFL's hottest offense to only 20 points and continued its improved play. With a game next week against Arizona, the Commanders have a chance to get to .500. Here are the most important things to know for both teams: Washington Commanders (4-5-1) Trend to watch: Running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt returned from a groin injury and provided a boost. stories.title: Jayden Daniels rallies Commanders in final seconds to set up winning kick in 22-20 win over Bengals
stories.summary: — Jayden Daniels connected with rookie Antonio Williams on two long pass plays, moving the Commanders 64 yards in 34 seconds to set up Drew Stevens’
stories.detail: LANDOVER, Md. -- — Jayden Daniels connected with rookie Antonio Williams on two long pass plays, moving the Commanders 64 yards in 34 seconds to set up Drew Stevens’ 26-yard field goal as time expired, and the Washington Commanders stunned Joe Burrow and the Cincinnati Bengals 22-20 on Monday night. After Evan McPherson put the Bengals ahead 20-19 on a 56-yard field goal , Washington got the ball back with 39 seconds left and no timeouts. Daniels hit Williams over the middle for 22 yards, spiked the ball, then found him again for a 42-yard catch-and-run to the Cincinnati 8. The QB spiked it with 5 seconds left and Stevens did the rest. Daniels finished with 283 yards passing, Williams had nine catches for 122 yards, and Stevens was 5 for 5 on field goals as Washington (4-5-1) remained in the NFC East race, two games behind the division-leading New York Giants . Burrow threw for 300 yards and two touchdowns for AFC North-leading Cincinnati (7-3), but the Commanders largely held in check a Bengals team that had won five straight, scoring 31 points or more each time. stories.detail: MINNEAPOLIS, MINNESOTA - NOVEMBER 9: Maxwell Hairston #1 of the Buffalo Bills celebrates after a play during the third quarter against the Minnesota Vikings at U.S. Bank Stadium on November 9, 2026 in Minneapolis, Minnesota. (Photo by Kevin Sabitus/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Buffalo Bills took care of business against an underdog on Sunday, beating the Miami Dolphins. The Jacksonville Jaguars and Cincinnati Bengals both lost to underdogs from the NFC East on Sunday and Monday, which paves the way for the Bills to clinch the number one seed in a new scenario. Yes, with seven games left it is premature to talk about clinching scenarios, but the Bills have a four-game lead in the AFC East plus two games left against the Jets and Dolphins. The division crown is heavily tilted toward the Bills now, and we are starting to look past that to the one seed. (The Bills are obvously focused one game at a time.) With the Jaguars and Bengals losing this week, the Bills now can win the rest of their AFC games and secure the overall record and the AFC record they would need to clinch the one seed, a status that has eluded them throughout Josh Allen’s entire career. stories.title: Lakers honor longtime PA announcer Lawrence Tanter
stories.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers honored longtime public address announcer Lawrence Tanter by unveiling a plaque at Crypto.com Arena on Monday, Nov. 23.
stories.detail: The Los Angeles Lakers honored longtime public address announcer Lawrence Tanter by unveiling a plaque at Crypto.com Arena on Monday, Nov. 23. Tanter spent 43 seasons in that role for the franchise before his death at 76 on Sept. 23 . Tanter had officially retired in June. He had called more than 2,100 games, including 14 NBA Finals series and four NBA All-Star Games, during his tenure. The Lakers played a tribute video during the game that included remarks from Lakers legends Michael Cooper and Mychal Thompson. Fans were also given the opportunity to write messages and memories in honor of Tanter in the Star Plaza outside of the Lakers’ home arena. Lakers coach JJ Redick also shared some thoughts about Tanter before the game against the Utah Jazz on Monday. "He's an iconic voice," Redick told reporters. "He made a mark not only on the Lakers but the NBA." “The first time I ever got to play in Staples Center, the curtains dropped from the scoreboard and the music came on and you hear his voice. … It just felt like I made the NBA. He was an integral part of what made this place so special.” This article originally appeared on USA TODAY: Lakers honor longtime PA announcer Lawrence T…

stories.summary: — Jalen Green scored 25 points, Devin Booker added 22, and the Phoenix Suns defeated the New Orleans Pelicans, 123-119 in overtime on Monday night.
stories.detail: NEW ORLEANS -- — Jalen Green scored 25 points, Devin Booker added 22, and the Phoenix Suns defeated the New Orleans Pelicans , 123-119 in overtime on Monday night. Collin Gillespie scored five of his 18 points in overtime, and Miles Bridges had 13 points and 11 rebounds for Phoenix, which won its fourth straight game while handing New Orleans its fourth straight loss. Jordan Poole scored 28 points — all in the first three quarters — and Zion Williamson added 25 points for the Pelicans, who've dropped 10 of 11 since starting 4-4. Saddiq Bey added 21 points and Jeremiah Fears had 11 assists for New Orleans. But Fears, who'd scored 29 points in a loss at San Antonio on Saturday, missed 14 of 17 shots against Phoenix. Trey Murphy also struggled as he works his way back from knee soreness that had sidelined him for seven of New Orleans' previous eight games. He shot 4 of 14 from the floor, and 1 of 6 from 3-point range. The Suns pulled away for good with a 10-4 run during overtime that included Booker's jumper, Gillespie's layup as he was fouled and Bridges' 3. Phoenix also led 109-107 with 31 seconds left in regulation after Booker's step-back jumper. Fears' driving scoop tied it at 1…

stories.title: Josh Kushner and Bob Iger spotted at Lakers-Jazz game
stories.summary: Josh Kushner and Bob Iger attended the Los Angeles Lakers vs. Utah Jazz game alongside Lakers governor Jeanie Buss on Monday, Nov. 23.
stories.detail: Josh Kushner and Bob Iger attended the Los Angeles Lakers vs. Utah Jazz game alongside Lakers governor Jeanie Buss on Monday, Nov. 23. The trio was seen sitting among the crowd at Crypto.com Arena. It was the first game they’ve attended since agreeing in August to purchase the team from Mark Walter at a $12.5 billion valuation. Kushner and Iger have talked with Buss about her role with the organization throughout the sale process. Kushner also went through the franchise's "back-of-house space" with Rob Pelinka, the Lakers president of basketball operations and general manager, according to ESPN's Dave McMenamin. The terms for the sale were agreed upon and finalized in October, but the deal still needs to be reviewed and approved by the NBA. Iger previously served as COO and CEO of The Walt Disney Company. Josh Kushner is known as an American businessman. Walter remains a co-owner of the Los Angeles Dodgers . This article originally appeared on USA TODAY: Josh Kushner and Bob Iger spotted at Lakers-Jazz game

stories.title: Kevin Durant scores 32 to power Rockets past Clippers 116-104
stories.summary: — Kevin Durant scored 32 points and Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson each had 20 to lead the Houston Rockets to a 116-104 win over the Los Angeles Clippers on Monday night.
stories.detail: HOUSTON -- — Kevin Durant scored 32 points and Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson each had 20 to lead the Houston Rockets to a 116-104 win over the Los Angeles Clippers on Monday night. Houston led by six points with about three minutes remaining before Durant made consecutive 3-pointers to make it 109-97. Brandon Ingram made a basket for Los Angeles but an off-balance 3 by Durant seconds later put the Rockets up 112-99 with 1:30 remaining. Ingram made his debut with the Clippers after sitting out since May following surgery for a heel injury and to repair a partially torn Achilles tendon. The two-time All-Star joined the Clippers in September from Toronto as part of the trade for Kawhi Leonard . He missed the last two games of Toronto’s first-round playoff series against Cleveland because of the injury. He had 16 points and seven rebounds in 27 minutes. Darius Garland had 26 points and eight assists to lead the Clippers, who lost their fourth straight. Rui Hachimura added 19 points. The game was tied midway through the third quarter before the Rockets used a 9-0 run, capped by a 3 from Tari Eason , to make it 74-65. Houston led by 10 entering the fourth. teamStories.summary: Less than two hours prior to tipoff Monday, the San Antonio Spurs ruled Victor Wembanyama and De'Aaron Fox out of their game against the Sacramento Kings, but the club anticipates both will play in Wednesday's game against the Portland Trail Blazers.
teamStories.detail: SACRAMENTO, Calif. -- Ninety minutes prior to tipoff Monday, the San Antonio Spurs ruled Victor Wembanyama and De'Aaron Fox out of their game against the Sacramento Kings . The Spurs are anticipating both will return for the team's Wednesday night game against the Portland Trail Blazers in advance of a showcase Friday night NBA Cup game at home against the 14-3 Los Angeles Lakers . Wembanyama is sitting with lower back tightness after appearing in each of the team's first 17 games. Fox is out with a right shin contusion after he was kicked during a recent win over the New Orleans Pelicans . The Spurs are already without Dylan Harper , who is expected to miss between one and three weeks with a hip strain. In the absence of three of their biggest names, the 14-3 Spurs are starting Stephon Castle , Devin Vassell , Julian Champagnie , Harrison Barnes and Luke Kornet against the 2-14 Kings. The Boston Celtics did something similar Saturday night, resting Jayson Tatum and Derrick White on the front side of a back-to-back in Sacramento.
